landing.softwareThatWorksKnowledgeThatLightsThe: Software That Works, Knowledge That Lights the Way. Welcome to
landing.mashalifyIsASoftwareDevelopmentCompanyBu: Mashalify is a software development company building websites, apps and custom software for clients on Upwork, Fiverr and locally. We also run Mashal al Quran, an online academy for the Quran, Islamic studies and technology, and a blog on Islamic and technology topics.
landing.oneTeamForSoftwareLearningAndKnowledge: One team for software, learning and knowledge, built to help you reach your goals.
landing.technologyAndKnowledgeUnderOneLight: Technology and Knowledge, Under One Light
landing.mashalifyTakesItsNameFromMashalThe: Mashalify takes its name from “mashal”, the Arabic word for torch. We are a software development company with an academy for the Quran and Islamic studies. Each part of Mashalify has its own website, so you can go straight to what you need.
landing.weBuildWebsitesMobileAppsAndCustom: We build websites, mobile apps and custom software for clients around the world.
landing.ourDevelopersAndQuranTeachersAreQualifie: Our developers and Quran teachers are qualified and experienced in their fields.
landing.everyClientAndStudentIsDifferentSo: Every client and student is different, so we adapt our work and lessons to your needs.
landing.youCanHireUsOnUpworkOr: You can hire us on Upwork or Fiverr, or work with us directly on local projects.
landing.ourBlogSharesIslamicAndTechnologyArticle: Our blog shares Islamic and technology articles for everyone.
landing.chooseTheServiceYouNeedFromCustom: Choose the service you need, from custom software to Quran lessons.
landing.mashalifyCombinesModernTechnologyClearCo: Mashalify combines modern technology, clear communication and genuine care for every client and student, in every project and every lesson.
landing.ourDevelopersDesignersAndTeachersWorkTog: Our developers, designers and teachers work together to deliver quality in everything we do.
landing.ourPlansAreDesignedToBeAffordable: Our plans are designed to be affordable, with a focus on value for clients and students.
landing.weHaveSharedSomeOfTheMost: We have shared some of the most frequently asked questions to help you out.
landing.weBuildWebsitesWebAppsMobileApps: We build websites, web apps, mobile apps and custom software. We also provide design, fixes and updates after launch.
landing.canIHireYouOnUpworkOr: Can I hire you on Upwork or Fiverr?
landing.yesYouCanHireMashalifyOnUpwork: Yes. You can hire Mashalify on Upwork or Fiverr, or contact us directly for local projects.
landing.mashalAlQuranIsOurOnlineAcademy: Mashal al Quran is our online academy for the Quran and Islamic studies. It has its own website, separate from our software site.
landing.whichCoursesDoesTheAcademyOffer: Which courses does the academy offer?
landing.theAcademyTeachesQuranReadingWithTajweed: The academy teaches Quran reading with Tajweed, Islamic studies and technology skills. Visit the academy website for current courses.
landing.howDoIStartASoftwareProject: How do I start a software project?
landing.sendUsAMessageFromTheContact: Send us a message from the contact section and tell us what you need. We will reply with questions and next steps.
landing.howLongDoesAProjectTake: How long does a project take?
landing.itDependsOnTheSizeAndFeatures: It depends on the size and features of the project. We give you a clear timeline once we understand your requirements.
landing.doYouWorkWithLocalClients: Do you work with local clients?
landing.yesWeTakeLocalProjectsAndCan: Yes. We take local projects and can work with you directly.
landing.doYouProvideSupportAfterLaunch: Do you provide support after launch?
landing.yesWeProvideFixesUpdatesAndSupport: Yes. We provide fixes, updates and support after we deliver your project.
landing.whatWillIFindOnTheBlog: What will I find on the blog?
landing.ourBlogPublishesArticlesOnIslamicTopics: Our blog publishes articles on Islamic topics, technology and more.
landing.whereCanIFindYourWebsites: Where can I find your websites?
landing.eachPartOfMashalifyHasItsOwn: Each part of Mashalify has its own subdomain: Mashalify for technology, Mashal al Quran for the academy, and the blog. You can find the links in the footer.
landing.contactUsAnyTimeAndWeWill: Contact us any time and we will reply as soon as possible. Academy class times are listed on the academy website.
landing.useTheContactFormInTheContact: Use the contact form in the Contact Us section or email us. We answer every message.

landing.customerSatisfactionAndExperienceAreOurT: Customer satisfaction and experience are our top priorities.
